title: Reproducibility as a function
caption: The same output requires every pipeline input at the same version: code, data, configuration and environment. A model artifact without its versions cannot be reproduced.

symbols.name: training pipeline
symbols.meaning: The deterministic function producing the model.

symbols.name: code version
symbols.meaning: The exact source revision of the pipeline.

symbols.name: data version
symbols.meaning: The versioned dataset and feature schemas.

symbols.name: config version
symbols.meaning: Hyperparameters and settings for the run.

symbols.name: environment
symbols.meaning: The execution environment — dependencies, hardware, seeds.

title: Training-serving skew as a recurring loss
caption: Daily loss from a consistency bug = requests × skewed fraction × loss per error. At 1M requests, 1% skew and \$0.10 per error: \$1,000/day, \$365,000 every year until the cause is removed.

symbols.name: daily loss
symbols.meaning: Business loss per day attributable to the skew.

symbols.name: daily queries
symbols.meaning: Requests served per day.

symbols.name: skew rate
symbols.meaning: Fraction of queries receiving skew-corrupted predictions.

symbols.name: cost per error
symbols.meaning: Estimated business loss per corrupted prediction.

title: Stage-gate evidence is priced in requests
caption: Sample size for detecting an effect grows with outcome variance and shrinks with the square of the minimum detectable effect — halving the MDE quadruples the traffic a canary stage needs.

symbols.name: sample size
symbols.meaning: Observations needed to detect the effect.

symbols.name: outcome variance
symbols.meaning: Variance of the metric under comparison.

symbols.name: minimum detectable effect
symbols.meaning: Smallest change the stage is designed to certify.

title: The optimal retraining interval
caption: Amortized run cost meets accrued staleness at the square root. For the ranking service — \$5,000 per run, 1M queries/day, \$0.50 per unit accuracy, 0.24%/day decay — T* ≈ 3 days.

symbols.name: optimal interval
symbols.meaning: Retraining cadence minimizing staleness + run cost per unit time.

symbols.name: run cost
symbols.meaning: Fixed cost of one retraining run: compute, validation, rollout.

symbols.name: daily traffic
symbols.meaning: Queries per day.

symbols.name: value per accuracy
symbols.meaning: Dollar value per query per unit accuracy change.

symbols.name: initial accuracy
symbols.meaning: Accuracy immediately after a retrain.

symbols.name: decay rate
symbols.meaning: Daily fractional accuracy loss to drift.

title: Staleness decay as a half-life
caption: Exponential accuracy decay fitted to the observed slide: at 0.24%/day a 94% baseline reaches ~88% in about four weeks. The half-life puts deployments with different decay rates on one scale.

symbols.name: accuracy at age t
symbols.meaning: Predictive quality t days after the last retrain.

symbols.name: initial accuracy
symbols.meaning: Accuracy at deployment or retrain.

symbols.name: decay rate
symbols.meaning: Fractional accuracy lost per day.

symbols.name: deployment age
symbols.meaning: Days since the model last trained.

title: Monitoring benefit/cost
caption: Monitoring pays when prevented incidents outweigh its cost: 5 prevented incidents at \$50K against \$50K of spend is a 5× benefit/cost — and it sizes which metrics deserve fine-grained observation.

symbols.name: incidents prevented
symbols.meaning: Incidents caught or avoided per period.

symbols.name: cost per incident
symbols.meaning: Loss per undetected incident (downtime, engineering time, reputation).

symbols.name: monitoring cost
symbols.meaning: Spend on telemetry, alerting and on-call.
